# UI QA Review — Cashier Console (1440px)

## 1. TEXT OVERLAP / CLIPPING

- **Card titles truncated with ellipses** (not overlapping, but clipped by design/overflow):
  - Card 2 title: "Lunch (cant..." — clipped.
  - Card 3 title: "Breakfast (..." — clipped.
  - Card 4 title: "Extra Class..." — clipped.
  - Card 5 title: "Transport F..." — clipped.
  - Only Card 1 "Sachet Water" shows its full title.
- **Chips/badges** (REQ, OPT, WKLY, prepaid, arrears): No overlap or clipping observed. "WKLY" sits cleanly on the Sachet Water card; "REQ" and "OPT" badges sit in card corners; "PREPAID" and "ARREARS" labels are fully visible.
- **Price text** ("₵8.00 /d", "₵5.00 /d", "₵5.00 /wk", "₵2.25 /d", "₵6.50 /d"): all fully visible, no truncation or collision.
- **Header/top bar**: no overlap. Date fields show truncated values "9 Nov 2…" and "9 Nov 2…" — the year is cut off in both From/To inputs (minor defect).
- No text-on-text overlap detected anywhere.

## 2. CARD CONTENTS (per card)

| # | Card | (a) Title | (b) Price | (c) Collect checkbox row | (d) Amount input |
|---|------|-----------|-----------|--------------------------|------------------|
| 1 | Sachet Water (blue) | ✅ "Sachet Water" | ✅ "₵5.00 /wk" | ✅ "Collect" (checkbox checked, teal) | ✅ "5.00" |
| 2 | Lunch / canteen (pink/red) | ✅ "Lunch (cant…" (truncated) | ✅ "₵8.00 /d" | ✅ "Collect" (checked) | ✅ "8.00" |
| 3 | Breakfast (light pink) | ✅ "Breakfast (…" (truncated) | ✅ "₵5.00 /d" | ✅ "Collect*" (unchecked, grayed) | ✅ "0.00" (grayed/disabled look) |
| 4 | Extra Classes (purple) | ✅ "Extra Class…" (truncated) | ✅ "₵2.25 /d" | ✅ "Collect" (checked) | ✅ "2.25" |
| 5 | Transport Fare (violet) | ✅ "Transport F…" (truncated) | ✅ "₵6.50 /d" | ✅ "Collect" (checked) | ✅ "6.50" |

All 5 cards also show a "settles ₵0.00 · banks ₵X.XX" footer line. Cards 2/3/5 show REQ/OPT/REQ badges respectively; card 1 shows WKLY.

## 3. LAYOUT

- All 5 cards are on **one single horizontal row** with **equal widths**, no wrapping and no vertical misalignment of tops/bottoms.
- Note: this row sits **beside the student panel** (Perpetual Baidoo card), not full-width — the left column takes ~420px and the 5-card row occupies the remaining width. That appears intentional, not a defect.
- The top summary row (6 colored summary tiles: Breakfast ₵247.50, Lunch ₵440.00, Sachet Water ₵0.00, Extra Classes ₵0.00, Transport Fare ₵21.00, TOTAL TODAY ₵708.50) is also aligned in one row, evenly spaced.

## 4. OTHER DEFECTS / OBSERVATIONS

1. **Truncated card titles** (4 of 5 cards) — as listed above. Most significant polish issue; titles are unreadable ("Lunch (cant…", "Transport F…").
2. **Date inputs clipped**: "9 Nov 2…" in both From and To fields — year not visible.
3. **Bottom cut-off**: content at page bottom is clipped by the viewport — "Recent collections" shows a third row "Cash ₵5.00" partially cut, and the Term invoices section shows a partially visible table header row ("Payment date / Method / Total / Tagged (?) / Close" barely visible). This is a scroll-state artifact, acceptable, but noted.
4. Minor inconsistency: Breakfast card has "Collect*" with an asterisk and a grayed-out "0.00" input — presumably intentional (optional fee), but the asterisk has no visible legend.
5. No overlapping elements, no broken icons, no misrendered currency symbols (₵ renders correctly throughout), no color/contrast failures that impede readability. Badge/notification count "1" on the bell renders correctly.

**Overall verdict:** Layout is solid and aligned; the only genuine defects are the four truncated card titles and the clipped date-field values.
